findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_verify, series_history, tr_fuel_prices · Private data: iban_validate, sanctions_screen, shipping_identify, tr_invoice_build, tr_invoice_parse · Public sink: email_verify, eu_vat_validate, phone_validate, tr_fuel_prices, tr_invoice_build · Destructive: eu_vat_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_verify, series_history, tr_fuel_prices · Private data: iban_validate, sanctions_screen, shipping_identify, tr_invoice_build, tr_invoice_parse · Public sink: email_verify, eu_vat_validate, phone_validate, tr_fuel_prices, tr_invoice_build · Destructive: eu_vat_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
